ov: استبدال (الإنجليزية: Changeling) أو تشانجيلنج هو فيلم أمريكي إثارة من إخراج كلينت إيستوود وقصّة مايكل سترازنسكي، مستوحى من قصّة حقيقيّة حدثت في لوس أنجلوس سنة 1928 عن امرأة أدركت أن الطفل الذي ردّ إليها بعد فقدانه لم يكن ابنها الحقيقي. بعد مواجهة مع شرطة لوس أنجلس لتثبت الخطأ تعدّ مريضة نفسية وتنقل لمصحّة نفسية.
plotEn:
In 1928 Los Angeles, single mother Christine Collins returns home to find her 9-year-old son, Walter, missing. Reverend Gustav Briegleb publicizes Christine's plight and rails against the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) for incompetence, corruption and the extrajudicial punishment meted out by its "Gun Squad," led by Chief James E. Davis. Some five months later, the LAPD tells Christine that Walter has been found alive in Dekalb, Illinois, and organizes a reunion in Los Angeles in front of the press. Christine immediately realizes that the boy is not Walter. Captain J.J. Jones, the head of the LAPD's Juvenile Division, insists he is and pressures Christine into taking him home "on a trial basis."
Christine finds several physical characteristics proving the boy is not her son. Unlike Walter, he is circumcised and is about four inches shorter, in comparison to Walter’s growth chart. Jones produces a doctor who tells her that trauma has shrunk his spine, and whoever took Walter must have had him circumcised. Christine pleads with Jones to continue the search for Walter, but he chastises her and suggests that she is pretending the boy is not Walter so that she can be free of her parental responsibilities.
